details:
I can testify about how controversial the group system is actually rn. Some people appreciate it, but some clearly don't ; and more and more I can see why.

In a matter of five months, I got kicked 5 times without any explanation or reason, and banned from 3 groups with no assistance and for dull unfair reasons (group owner overreacting madly to me being friendly, me being upset by being manipulated by others, and toxic person for being banned by me while helping another group for solid reasons).

The point is, some groups clearly abuse their powers, in a way or another. While there is some interest having groups so people can find others who have same mentality, the main problem remains in the fact that as of today, people have the indirect habit of going into instances hold by groups, as a mark of "recognised". And when people are getting kicked or banned unfairly because of what's going on, they can't join others or even their friends playing on "popular" instances, which only leads to frustration.

Now, groups are also made for another reason, directly or indirectly : to ease vrc staff charge about moderation. But also there, there are reasons to wonder : recently again, vrc promoted people to use tools for auto-moderation, so they can handle the situations themselves. So what would be the point of groups anymore considering this angle ? Furthermore, it is common to see staff asking for people coming in their instances to not mute or block them (for moderating reasons) ; but it becomes against what vrc promotes in term of auto-moderation for players and free will (moreover when staff don't do anything to concretely understand and help people who can in top of that have troubles in a way or another).

An idea to keep groups spirit while making it not a risk to see vrc community tired of unfair handling, endless solution looking and talking, would be to split the cake : groups should have its own place in the menu, with their own promotions,  instances, events. When choosing a map, players should get the possibility of either going in a public place, or checking groups that are known for creating instances with this map ; but not in the form of listing, more in a form like a window with rectangles with pictures "public place", "groups - find communities around this map !" and showing icons of groups with active instances, along with number of people in it. This way, making everyone happy the cleanest way.
title: Group system should be apart from instances lists
